Name: Maasai Beaded Fringe Collar
Description: A rope-style beaded collar finished with brass end caps, falling into a deep curtain of fringe. The strands change colour along their length, so the piece reads as one tone at the neck and another at the hem.

Name: Beaded Net Cape Collar
Description: A wide beaded cape worked in open diamond mesh, filled with bands of accent colour and finished with a long pointed fringe. Sits over the shoulders rather than at the throat.

Name: Beaded Torsade Rope Necklace
Description: Multi-strand torsade of pearlised seed beads twisted into a single thick braid, finished with coiled brass wire end caps and a hook clasp.

Name: Maasai Beaded Medallion Necklace
Short description: Glass seed beads, brass end caps
Description: Beaded rope necklace blocked with bands of contrasting colour and hung with two flat circular beaded medallions, finished with brass end caps.

Name: Graduated Wooden Bead Necklace
Description: Round wooden beads graded from small at the nape to bold spheres at the front. Each strand is dyed and polished by hand, so tone varies slightly between pieces.
Attribute 1 value(s): Red | Orange | Teal | Yellow | Multicolour | Natural

Name: Graduated Ceramic Bead Necklace
Description: Glazed ceramic beads graded toward the centre front and strung on knotted cord with a sliding closure, so the length adjusts to the wearer.
Attribute 1 value(s): Cream | Black | Grey | Pink | Olive | Blue | Red | Yellow | Teal

Name: Maasai Beaded Leather Cuff
Description: Wide leather-backed cuff, beaded by hand and lined in dark suede with metal snap fasteners. Patterns run from flag stripes to concentric eyes and swirls, and rotate with what the beaders are making.
Attribute 1 value(s): Kenyan Flag | Swirl | Concentric Eye | Assorted pattern

Name: Beaded Wire Basket
Description: Lidded basket built by threading glass beads onto wire and coiling them into shape by hand. Used for jewellery, trinkets and small keepsakes.
Attribute 1 value(s): Gold | Black & Gold | Silver | Navy Speckle

Name: Beaded Wire Trinket Pot
Description: Small coiled pot in iridescent beads speckled with colour, its lid topped with a looped beaded bow. Sits in the palm of a hand.

Name: Maasai Beaded Leather Coasters
Description: Coasters of coiled seed beads set into leather discs with plaited leather edging, worked in concentric rings and spirals.
Attribute 1 value(s): Red & Gold | Black & White | Brown & Gold | Blue Spiral

Name: Fringed Sisal Placemat
Description: Round woven sisal placemat with a long shaggy fringe, in natural and dyed colourways with concentric banding.

Name: Woven Sisal Bowls
Description: Nested woven sisal bowls, either trimmed at the rim with seed beads or banded in dyed fibre. Sold as a nesting set.

Name: Hammered Brass Earrings
Description: Hand-hammered brass earrings in ankh, Africa, comb, hoop, spiral, triangle and leaf shapes. Shapes rotate with what is in stock.

Name: Beaded & Cowrie Shell Earrings
Short description: Glass beads, cowrie shell, leather, wood
Description: Beaded hoops, tassels, cowrie shells, leather teardrops and carved wooden shapes. Styles rotate; ask us what is in stock.

Name: Brass Bangles & Cuffs
Description: Hammered, twisted-wire and spiral brass bangles and open cuffs, worn singly or stacked. Finishes vary between pieces as each is worked by hand.
Attribute 1 value(s): Hammered | Twisted wire | Spiral | Wide cuff

Name: Horn & Resin Bangles
Description: Smooth bangles turned from horn and bone in natural browns and creams, alongside solid resin bangles in bright colours.

Name: Brass Collar Necklace
Description: Statement neckpiece in polished brass — a smooth crescent collar, or layered wire coiled into a torque.

Name: Beaded Belt
Description: Long beaded belt worked in vertical strands of colour on a leather backing, fastening with a beaded tab.

Name: Flat Beaded Band
Description: Flat woven band of seed beads, worn on the wrist or upper arm. Woven in flag stripes and geometric repeats.

Name: Carved Gourd
Description: Dried gourd dyed deep red and incised with giraffe and wildlife motifs, finished with a fitted lid.

Name: Leather Wallets & Card Holders
Description: Hand-stitched leather wallets and card holders, some tooled with African motifs.

Name: Banana Fibre Wall Art
Description: Framed pictures built up from layered banana fibre and bark, showing village and wildlife scenes.

Name: African Print Fabric Fan
Description: Folding hand fan in printed cotton on a wooden frame, in assorted African prints.
